rules.name: even_ranks_only
rules.description: Only cards with an even rank (2,4,6,8,10,12) may be played.
rules.code: return card.rank % 2 == 0

rules.name: odd_ranks_only
rules.description: Only cards with an odd rank (1,3,5,7,9,11,13) may be played.
rules.code: return card.rank % 2 == 1

rules.name: face_cards_only
rules.description: Only face cards (11,12,13) may be played.
rules.code: return card.rank in (11, 12, 13)

rules.name: number_cards_only
rules.description: Only number cards (1-10) may be played.
rules.code: return card.rank <= 10

rules.name: multiples_of_three
rules.description: Only ranks that are multiples of three (3,6,9,12) are allowed.
rules.code: return card.rank % 3 == 0

rules.name: ranks_5_to_9
rules.description: Only cards whose rank is between 5 and 9 inclusive may be played.
rules.code: return 5 <= card.rank <= 9

rules.name: aces_or_kings_only
rules.description: Only Aces (rank 1) or Kings (rank 13) may be placed.
rules.code: return card.rank in (1, 13)

rules.name: aces_only
rules.description: Only Aces (rank 1) may be placed.
rules.code: return card.rank == 1

rules.name: perfect_square_ranks
rules.description: Only ranks that are perfect squares (1, 4, 9) may be played.
rules.code: return card.rank in {1, 4, 9}

rules.name: prime_ranks_only
rules.description: Only prime number ranks (2,3,5,7,11,13) may be played.
rules.code:
primes = {2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13}
return card.rank in primes

rules.name: multiples_of_4_or_5
rules.description: Only ranks that are multiples of 4 or 5 (4, 5, 8, 10, 12) may be played.
rules.code:
allowed = {4, 5, 8, 10, 12}
return card.rank in allowed

rules.name: opposite_parity
rules.description: Card rank must have opposite odd/even parity to the previous card's rank.

rules.name: alternating_face_number
rules.description: Alternate face and number cards.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
prev_is_face = mainline[-1].rank >= 11
curr_is_face = card.rank >= 11
return curr_is_face != prev_is_face

rules.name: rank_opposite_side
rules.description: If the previous rank was <7, the new card must be >7. If the previous rank was >7, the new card must be <7. 7 is forbidden.

rules.name: no_consecutive_same_rank
rules.description: No two consecutive cards may have the same rank.

rules.name: alternating_digit_count
rules.description: Digit Count: You must alternate between single-digit ranks (A–9) and double-digit ranks.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
curr_single = card.rank <= 9
prev_single = mainline[-1].rank <= 9
return curr_single != prev_single

rules.name: rank_pairs
rules.description: Rank repeats in pairs: ranks must come in doubles: (x, x), then a different rank (y, y), then different (z, z)…

rules.name: parity_pairs
rules.description: Parity repeats in pairs : two odd ranks, then two even ranks, then two odd ranks, etc.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
pos = len(mainline) + 1
pair_index = (pos - 1) // 2
expected_odd = pair_index % 2 == 0
actual_odd = card.rank % 2 == 1
return actual_odd == expected_odd

rules.name: non_decreasing_ranks
rules.description: Each card must have a rank greater than or equal to the previous card; any card may start the line. No cycle allowed.

rules.name: nonincreasing_no_cycle
rules.description: Each card must have a rank less than or equal to the previous card; any card may start the line. No cycle allowed.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
prev_rank = mainline[-1].rank
if card.rank > prev_rank:
    return False
# reject if this rank has already appeared (prevents cycles/repeats)
return card.rank not in [c.rank for c in mainline]

rules.name: strictly_increasing_rank_with_ace_wrap
rules.description: Each card must have a rank strictly greater than the previous card; any card may start the line. Ace may follow King.

rules.name: decreasing_with_king_after_ace
rules.description: Each card must have a rank strictly less than the previous card; any card may start the line. King may follow Ace.

rules.name: rank_diff_at_most_two
rules.description: The absolute difference between this card’s rank and the previous card’s rank must be less than or equal to 2.

rules.name: adjacent_ranks_wrap
rules.description: The absolute difference between this card’s rank and the previous card’s rank must be exactly 1. Ace may follow King and vice versa.

rules.name: consecutive_sum_gt_seven
rules.description: Each pair of consecutive cards must have ranks that sum to more than 7.

rules.name: spades_only
rules.description: Only cards of the suit spades may be played.
rules.code: return card.suit.suit_name == "spades"

rules.name: major_suits_only
rules.description: Major vs. Minor: Only cards from the "Major Suits" (Hearts and Spades) may be played.
rules.code: return card.suit.suit_name in ("hearts", "spades")

rules.name: spades_and_diamonds_only
rules.description: Only spades and diamonds may be played.

rules.name: red_cards_only
rules.description: Every card must be red (hearts or diamonds).

rules.name: black_cards_only
rules.description: Every card must be black (spades or clubs).
rules.code: return card.color == "black"

rules.name: different_suit
rules.description: The card must be of a different suit than the card just before it. Any card may start the line.

rules.name: different_suit_same_color
rules.description: The card must be of a different suit than but same color as the card just before it. Any card may start the line.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
prev = mainline[-1]
return card.color == prev.color and card.suit.suit_name != prev.suit.suit_name

rules.name: ordered_suit_cycle
rules.description: Suits must repeat in the order hearts → spades → clubs → diamonds → hearts …
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
order = ["hearts", "spades", "clubs", "diamonds"]
last_suit = mainline[-1].suit.suit_name
idx = order.index(last_suit)
expected = order[(idx + 1) % 4]
return card.suit.suit_name == expected

rules.name: tri_cycle_suits
rules.description: Suits repeat every three cards in the order hearts → clubs → spades → hearts … (diamonds never appear).
rules.code:
order = ("hearts", "clubs", "spades")
expected = order[len(mainline) % 3]
return card.suit.suit_name == expected

rules.name: suit_pairs_alternating
rules.description: Suits must appear in pairs: card 1 and 2 same suit, cards 3 and 4 same suit (different from 1 and 2), cards 5 and 6 same suit (different from 3 and 4), etc.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
# Determine position of the new card (1-indexed)
# len(mainline) is the number of cards already accepted
if len(mainline) % 2 == 0:
    # This card starts a new pair: must differ from the previous pair's suit
    prev_suit = mainline[-1].suit.suit_name
    return card.suit.suit_name != prev_suit
else:
    # This card completes a pair: must match the suit of the first card in this pair
    return card.suit.suit_name == mainline[-1].suit.suit_name

rules.name: suit_changes_every_three
rules.description: The suit changes every three cards; the first three may be any suit, the next three must be a different suit, and so on.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True

i = len(mainline)                 # index of the new card (0‑based)
group = i // 3
pos_in_group = i % 3

if group == 0:
    # first three cards may be any suit
    return True

if pos_in_group == 0:
    # first card of a new three‑card block must differ from previous block's suit
    prev_suit = mainline[i - 1].suit.suit_name
    return card.suit.suit_name != prev_suit
else:
    # subsequent cards in the block must match the block's suit
    block_suit = mainline[i - pos_in_group].suit.suit_name
    return card.suit.suit_name == block_suit

rules.name: suit_diff_last_two
rules.description: The card’s suit must differ from each of the previous two suits (if they exist).

rules.name: alternating_groups
rules.description: Hearts and spades form Group A; clubs and diamonds form Group B. Alternate between groups.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
prev_group = mainline[-1].suit.suit_name in ("hearts", "spades")
curr_group = card.suit.suit_name in ("hearts", "spades")
return curr_group != prev_group

rules.name: alternating_colors
rules.description: Cards must alternate between red and black colors.

rules.name: color_triplet_blocks
rules.description: Colors must be the same in triplets: the first three cards must be the same color, the next three must be the opposite color, and so on.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
base_color = mainline[0].color
pos = len(mainline)  # index where the new card would be placed
block = pos // 3
required_color = base_color if block % 2 == 0 else ("black" if base_color == "red" else "red")
return card.color == required_color

rules.name: max_two_consecutive_color
rules.description: No more than two consecutive cards may be the same color.

rules.name: even_match_odd_mismatch
rules.description: If the previous rank is even, the suit must match the previous suit; if odd, the suit must differ.

rules.name: even_keep_color_odd_switch
rules.description: If the previous rank is even, the new card must keep the same color; if odd, the color must switch.

rules.name: red_prime_ranks
rules.description: Only red cards whose rank is prime numbers (2,3,5,7,11,13) may be played.

rules.name: share_color_or_parity
rules.description: Each card must share at least one property with the previous card: same color, or same parity.

rules.name: red_increase_black_decrease
rules.description: If the previous card was red, rank must increase; if black, rank must decrease. Ace may follow King and vice versa.

rules.name: face_red_number_black
rules.description: Face cards must be red; number cards (1-10) must be black.

rules.name: face_card_suit_imposes
rules.description: Face cards imposes the suit: if a face card is played, the next card must match its suit. Otherwise, the next card must be a different suit than it.

rules.name: no_match_consecutive
rules.description: No attribute match rule: between consecutive cards, none of {color, parity, face-vs-number} may match.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
prev = mainline[-1]
color_ok = card.color != prev.color
parity_ok = (card.rank % 2) != (prev.rank % 2)
face_ok = (card.rank >= 11) != (prev.rank >= 11)
return color_ok and parity_ok and face_ok

rules.name: high_low_switch
rules.description: The High/Low Switch: If the previous card was Red, the played card must be High (8–K). If the previous card was Black, the played card must be Low (A–7).
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
prev = mainline[-1]
if prev.color == "red":
    return 8 <= card.rank <= 13
else:  # prev.color == "black"
    return 1 <= card.rank <= 7
